## Video Management System, PSIM, and Cloud VSaaS Solutions

### All-in-One: Intelligent Video Management System for Secure and Data-Driven Cities and
### Organizations

AxxonSoft is dedicated to helping cities and organizations of all sizes build secure, efficient, and
intelligent operations with Axxon One VMS — a powerful, scalable video management system. Enriched
with AI-powered advanced video analytics, Axxon One ensures seamless communication between all
system components, creating a unified, data-driven ecosystem. This enables timely and proactive
decision-making to enhance security and optimize workflows.

With intuitive and flexible solutions, Axxon One VMS streamlines operations and improves situational
awareness, giving cities and organizations complete control over their video management systems —
whether on-premises, in a hybrid environment, or in the cloud.

Enhance your security system’s decision-making capabilities and establish proactive surveillance
with the Axxon One intelligent VMS and its advanced video analytics solutions.

All-in-One Integrated Security
True Intelligence
Customization & Automation
Scalable Security

#### Unified Video Management System

Axxon One is a comprehensive security platform that smoothly combines video surveillance, access
control, analytics, and automation into a single, intelligent system. Seamlessly integrating with
your existing infrastructure, our VMS software provides unparalleled security and flexibility.

With our intelligent video analytics solution, you can effectively monitor and protect your
premises, taking advantage of our best-of-breed security system software that features seamless IP
integration and real-time monitoring.

This unified approach enhances situational awareness by providing real-time data, intelligent
alerts, and effortless interoperability across security components. By eliminating silos and
enabling centralized monitoring, Axxon One improves response times, reduces complexity, and
strengthens protection. Whether securing a single site or an expansive enterprise network, its
all-in-one design optimizes operations, boosts efficiency, and enhances overall security.

[ Gain in-depth knowledge ][167]

#### Intelligent Video Management System

With our comprehensive suite of video management solutions, including advanced VMS and intelligent
video analytics, we provide a powerful combination for your security system. Our expertise in AI
video management system development enables us to enhance your operations, improve efficiency, and
effectively predict and prevent abnormal situations. Axxon One AI VMS provides a powerful
combination for your security system, making it one of the top video management systems available.

Equipped with over 50 advanced detectors, Axxon One delivers real-time recognition, detection, and
instant search for next-level security management. The system leverages AI-powered analytics,
including facial recognition, license plate recognition (LPR), motion tracking, object detection,
crowd density analysis, audio classification, and behavioral analytics. With instant event search,
security teams can locate critical footage in seconds, significantly improving investigation times
and operational efficiency. The seamless integration of video analytics, access control, and
automated event handling makes Axxon One a scalable, future-ready security solution.

[ Gain in-depth knowledge ][168]

#### Tailor Video Management System to Your Needs

Axxon One is built for flexibility, adapting to the unique security needs of any organization. Its
customization options allow seamless integration with third-party systems and the ability to tailor
automation rules to specific security requirements. From triggering alarms and locking doors to
adjusting camera views, Axxon One VMS Software enables intelligent workflows that enhance security
operations and response times.

Designed for maximum adaptability, Axxon One offers extensive video management system (VMS)
customization, ensuring that your VMS works exactly the way you need it to.

Axxon One enhances situational awareness with advanced automation, allowing organizations to
optimize security operations through intelligent workflows. Whether activating alarms, adjusting
surveillance settings, or integrating AI-driven analytics, this AI video management system improves
efficiency and response times. Its user-centric interface is customizable and enables users to
personalize dashboards, create event notifications, and configure video management system features
like role-based access control to ensure team members see only relevant information.

[ Gain in-depth knowledge ][169]

#### Distributed Video Management System

Axxon One integrates multiple systems into a single, intelligent platform designed for hybrid and
distributed environments. Its centralized management interface allows security teams to monitor and
control diverse locations effortlessly. With converged architecture, Axxon One unifies video
surveillance, access control, fire and intruder alarms, and AI-driven analytics into a seamless
security ecosystem.

Scalable for any environment, Axxon One is a top video management system that grows with your
security needs. Whether for small businesses or large-scale city surveillance, its modular
architecture allows seamless expansion, additional integrations, and enhanced functionality. As an
intelligent video management system, Axxon One provides an adaptable, AI-powered security solution
for organizations of all sizes.

Whether securing a single facility or a global network, Axxon One delivers the scalability,
automation, and intelligence needed for next-generation security management. Its IP video management
system capabilities ensure flexible deployment, while its enterprise-grade performance makes it the
best video management system for businesses requiring robust security solutions tailored to their
unique operational demands.

## OUR MISSION: ITAD for A Better Planet

### WE REDUCE: We Reduce IT’s Impact on the Planet Through IT Asset Disposition

Electronics have an effect on the planet through every step of their lifecycle—from the destruction
of ecosystems as raw materials are extracted, to the manufacturing process, through use, to when
they reach the end of their lifespan. E-waste often contains hazardous substances like lead, mercury
and brominated flame retardants. These toxic substances are released into the environment—whether
the e-waste is disposed of in a landfill or incinerated—leading to ground and air pollution and
health risks.

There is no planet B. CentricsIT is on a mission to help companies dispose of their IT hardware in a
safe, secure way that minimizes ecological impact. An ITAD company with more than 18 years of
experience in giving IT hardware new life, CentricsIT is committed to reducing the ecological
effects of IT by prioritizing reuse and championing recycling.

[Sand dune against a blue sky]

### WE REUSE: We Prepare IT Equipment for Reuse through ITAD

The greenest form of recycling is reuse, which is why an ITAD company like CentricsIT is committed
to helping companies get the most out of their equipment through refurbishment and remarketing. The
production of new electronic devices requires the extraction and processing of raw materials. These
processes emit greenhouse gases and other pollutants while also contributing to the destruction of
habitats around the world.

As an ITAD company, our services address this waste stream by prioritizing reuse of IT hardware
through our programs. These programs add value to Environmental Social Governance (ESG) initiatives
by leveraging used hardware in ways beneficial to both the environment and social programs. Our ITAD
services prepare equipment for new life, offering programs that support remarketing, buyback
programs and donation to community groups. Reuse retains the value in the equipment, sharing that
value between your company, the community and the environment.

### WE RECYCLE: We Recycle according to R2

CentricsIT is R2 certified and only works with other R2-certified recyclers and ITAD companies,
ensuring environmental, quality, health and safety, and data security standards. When IT hardware
reaches not just EOL but the final end of its life, CentricsIT extracts valuable components from the
hardware and works with other recyclers to recover as much as possible throughout the ITAD process.

The R2, or Responsible Recycling certification, is adopted by organizations that process used
electronics, including ITAD companies. It is accredited by the [EPA][91] and housed by [SERI][92], a
non-profit organization that works to minimize environmental and health risks related to e-waste
while maximizing its value. It sets the standard as the most [widely adopted standard for used
electronics worldwide][93] and requires annual auditing to ensure quality and compliance.

## OUR PROMISE: Security and Data Protection in ITAD

### End-to-End Physical and Data Security through IT Asset Disposition

Data security within the ITAD process is our number one priority, beginning with a thorough data
wiping procedure for all data-bearing devices. This process often employs industry-standard data
erasure software that meets regulatory and compliance requirements, ensuring all data is
irreversibly destroyed. For devices that cannot be wiped effectively, physical destruction methods
such as shredding or degaussing are employed. CentricsIT provides a certificate of data destruction,
providing documented proof of compliance with data protection regulations.

**Take a virtual tour of our certified ITAD facility. **

## OUR VALUE: A MINDFUL ALTERNATIVE

### We Take a Channel-Alternative Approach to Global IT Hardware Sourcing and Procurement

**CentricsIT began as a global independent distributor of new and refurbished IT hardware, and we
remain a world leader today.** When you engage CentricsIT to procure your infrastructure equipment,
you gain access to our $10 million inventory and our global purchasing network, a significant
portion of which is supplied through ITAD.

Our manufacturer-specific product specialists source hardware on the global IT market every day,
which means fair market pricing for our clients that is completely independent of the OEM model.

Purchasing IT hardware on the secondary market **offers a more sustainable procurement method**
compared to traditional sourcing for several compelling reasons. Primarily, it** extends the
lifecycle of electronic devices**, reducing the overall demand for new production.

**CAMERON JAMES**
*Executive Vice President*

[network world logo]

“The best way to reduce IT waste is to use any product to its maximum lifespan, without compromising
on performance. This is easy to do. Many used products are N-1—just one generation back from the
latest OEM lines.”

Another benefit of sourcing used IT gear is the near-term availability of the products. “The
equipment is in stock and ready to ship—no lead times,” James says. “Especially now, when we’re
seeing lead times for new hardware into the hundreds of days, being able to receive what you need
overnight is critical.”

[READ THE ARTICLE ON NETWORK WORLD][94]

### Circular Sourcing

Acquiring surplus IT equipment can provide the same technological benefits and reliability as
purchasing directly from manufacturers, often at a reduced cost.

This approach not only supports sustainable consumption patterns but also **aligns with the
principles of a circular economy**, where the emphasis is on keeping products in use for as long as
possible.

### High Global Availability

With more than $10 million of inventory in stock, most quotes can be configured and shipped
worldwide within 24–48 hours, **eliminating OEM lead times.**

Our worldwide footprint is the product of our global trade expertise and experience handling
international customs. Our logistics experts and certified customs brokers ensure **we can import
and export hardware anywhere in the world**.

### Lower Cost of Ownership

Our independent status means that **we are not bound by OEM discount categories**, which gives us
access to the global marketplace and the best possible pricing.

**Altogether, our clients save 50–80% on their hardware purchases versus traditional distribution
channels.**

### Unbiased Recommendations

At CentricsIT, we pride ourselves on being vendor-neutral. We take a consultative approach when
making hardware recommendations and **offer products from all best-of-breed manufacturers**.

CentricsIT is **ISO certified**, and our engineers put every device through a rigorous inspection as
part of our quality control protocols. **Each system is configured to the customer’s
specifications.**

## OUR MISSION: ITAD for A Better Planet

### WE REDUCE: We Reduce IT’s Impact on the Planet Through IT Asset Disposition

Electronics have an effect on the planet through every step of their lifecycle—from the destruction
of ecosystems as raw materials are extracted, to the manufacturing process, through use, to when
they reach the end of their lifespan. E-waste often contains hazardous substances like lead, mercury
and brominated flame retardants. These toxic substances are released into the environment—whether
the e-waste is disposed of in a landfill or incinerated—leading to ground and air pollution and
health risks.

There is no planet B. CentricsIT is on a mission to help companies dispose of their IT hardware in a
safe, secure way that minimizes ecological impact. An ITAD company with more than 18 years of
experience in giving IT hardware new life, CentricsIT is committed to reducing the ecological
effects of IT by prioritizing reuse and championing recycling.

[Sand dune against a blue sky]

### WE REUSE: We Prepare IT Equipment for Reuse through ITAD

The greenest form of recycling is reuse, which is why an ITAD company like CentricsIT is committed
to helping companies get the most out of their equipment through refurbishment and remarketing. The
production of new electronic devices requires the extraction and processing of raw materials. These
processes emit greenhouse gases and other pollutants while also contributing to the destruction of
habitats around the world.

As an ITAD company, our services address this waste stream by prioritizing reuse of IT hardware
through our programs. These programs add value to Environmental Social Governance (ESG) initiatives
by leveraging used hardware in ways beneficial to both the environment and social programs. Our ITAD
services prepare equipment for new life, offering programs that support remarketing, buyback
programs and donation to community groups. Reuse retains the value in the equipment, sharing that
value between your company, the community and the environment.

### WE RECYCLE: We Recycle according to R2

CentricsIT is R2 certified and only works with other R2-certified recyclers and ITAD companies,
ensuring environmental, quality, health and safety, and data security standards. When IT hardware
reaches not just EOL but the final end of its life, CentricsIT extracts valuable components from the
hardware and works with other recyclers to recover as much as possible throughout the ITAD process.

The R2, or Responsible Recycling certification, is adopted by organizations that process used
electronics, including ITAD companies. It is accredited by the [EPA][91] and housed by [SERI][92], a
non-profit organization that works to minimize environmental and health risks related to e-waste
while maximizing its value. It sets the standard as the most [widely adopted standard for used
electronics worldwide][93] and requires annual auditing to ensure quality and compliance.

## OUR PROMISE: Security and Data Protection in ITAD

### End-to-End Physical and Data Security through IT Asset Disposition

Data security within the ITAD process is our number one priority, beginning with a thorough data
wiping procedure for all data-bearing devices. This process often employs industry-standard data
erasure software that meets regulatory and compliance requirements, ensuring all data is
irreversibly destroyed. For devices that cannot be wiped effectively, physical destruction methods
such as shredding or degaussing are employed. CentricsIT provides a certificate of data destruction,
providing documented proof of compliance with data protection regulations.

**Take a virtual tour of our certified ITAD facility. **

## OUR VALUE: A MINDFUL ALTERNATIVE

### We Take a Channel-Alternative Approach to Global IT Hardware Sourcing and Procurement

**CentricsIT began as a global independent distributor of new and refurbished IT hardware, and we
remain a world leader today.** When you engage CentricsIT to procure your infrastructure equipment,
you gain access to our $10 million inventory and our global purchasing network, a significant
portion of which is supplied through ITAD.

Our manufacturer-specific product specialists source hardware on the global IT market every day,
which means fair market pricing for our clients that is completely independent of the OEM model.

Purchasing IT hardware on the secondary market **offers a more sustainable procurement method**
compared to traditional sourcing for several compelling reasons. Primarily, it** extends the
lifecycle of electronic devices**, reducing the overall demand for new production.

**CAMERON JAMES**
*Executive Vice President*

[network world logo]

“The best way to reduce IT waste is to use any product to its maximum lifespan, without compromising
on performance. This is easy to do. Many used products are N-1—just one generation back from the
latest OEM lines.”

Another benefit of sourcing used IT gear is the near-term availability of the products. “The
equipment is in stock and ready to ship—no lead times,” James says. “Especially now, when we’re
seeing lead times for new hardware into the hundreds of days, being able to receive what you need
overnight is critical.”

[READ THE ARTICLE ON NETWORK WORLD][94]

### Circular Sourcing

Acquiring surplus IT equipment can provide the same technological benefits and reliability as
purchasing directly from manufacturers, often at a reduced cost.

This approach not only supports sustainable consumption patterns but also **aligns with the
principles of a circular economy**, where the emphasis is on keeping products in use for as long as
possible.

### High Global Availability

With more than $10 million of inventory in stock, most quotes can be configured and shipped
worldwide within 24–48 hours, **eliminating OEM lead times.**

Our worldwide footprint is the product of our global trade expertise and experience handling
international customs. Our logistics experts and certified customs brokers ensure **we can import
and export hardware anywhere in the world**.

### Lower Cost of Ownership

Our independent status means that **we are not bound by OEM discount categories**, which gives us
access to the global marketplace and the best possible pricing.

**Altogether, our clients save 50–80% on their hardware purchases versus traditional distribution
channels.**

### Unbiased Recommendations

At CentricsIT, we pride ourselves on being vendor-neutral. We take a consultative approach when
making hardware recommendations and **offer products from all best-of-breed manufacturers**.

CentricsIT is **ISO certified**, and our engineers put every device through a rigorous inspection as
part of our quality control protocols. **Each system is configured to the customer’s
specifications.**

questions and include short video clips, which I find useful.

## Your Trusted Advisors

# Your Plan, Your Dream, Your Future. Your Wealth Management Team.

[ Our Locations ][70]
[ Our Process ][71]

## About Us

In a precision timepiece, a mainspring is used to drive the entire mechanism. As the mainspring’s
energy is steadily released, each part of the timepiece is kept in continuous, precise motion. In
the same way, Mainspring Wealth Advisors acts as a driving force to keep the personal and financial
goals of our clients moving forward. You can be confident that the team at Mainspring is always at
work – like the unseen mainspring of a fine timepiece – helping to ensure that each financial
component of your life is kept in harmonious motion with the others. 

[ Meet the Team ][72]
[ Our Process ][73]

## Building A Financial Plan

In order to pursue your personal and financial goals, the many financial components of your life
must work together in harmony. This requires comprehensive planning and a detailed process to pull
it all together. You can learn about our process here.

1
Initial Consultation
Identify and clarify your goals, dreams, special concerns, and challenges.
2
Develop + Finalize Plan
Facilitate conversation around topics such as retirement planning, college savings, life insurance,
investment planning, tax strategies, estate planning, and charitable planning.
3
Execution + Implementation
Create action item list to include recommendations with appropriate schedule for implementation and
accountability.
4
Advancement Planning
Conduct reviews and consultations with outside experts, when appropriate.

## Our Services

Managing Wealth For A Wide Range Of Needs And Goals

Financial Planning

Your financial plan connects all the components of a comprehensive wealth management plan, including
investments, risk management, tax strategies, and estate planning strategies, acting as a roadmap to
help ensure your long-term goals are met.

Investment Management

We believe investing is a means to an end, and it all starts with your financial plan. We believe a
personalized financial plan is a prerequisite to a successful investing experience.

Estate and Legacy Planning

Build a holistic plan for your legacy that provides for loved ones and protects your estate.

Tax Planning

A proactive approach to tax planning helps you better understand what your tax situation may look
like in the future and how the decisions you make today can affect your future wealth.

Insurance and Asset Protection

One of the most important functions we serve is helping to protect all you have worked to build.

## Who We Serve

We serve many different clients with a variety of financial planning needs. Like them, your needs
are as individual as you are. As such, our team is proud – and pleased – to provide you with
professional guidance and an array of financial planning and wealth management services that can be
personalized to fit your situation.

### [ Individuals + Families ][74]

We work to allow clients to live their lives with a purpose and a freedom to focus on their family
and goals.

[ Learn More ][75]

### [ Business Owners ][76]

We partner with business owners to help ensure the stewardship of their legacies.

[ Learn More ][77]

### [ Pre-retirees ][78]

If you are one of the many Americans who plan to retire in the next five to 10 years, it’s time to
determine what shape your retirement savings are in.

[ Learn More ][79]

## Your Trusted Advisors

# Your Plan, Your Dream, Your Future. Your Wealth Management Team.

[ Our Locations ][70]
[ Our Process ][71]

## About Us

In a precision timepiece, a mainspring is used to drive the entire mechanism. As the mainspring’s
energy is steadily released, each part of the timepiece is kept in continuous, precise motion. In
the same way, Mainspring Wealth Advisors acts as a driving force to keep the personal and financial
goals of our clients moving forward. You can be confident that the team at Mainspring is always at
work – like the unseen mainspring of a fine timepiece – helping to ensure that each financial
component of your life is kept in harmonious motion with the others. 

[ Meet the Team ][72]
[ Our Process ][73]

## Building A Financial Plan

In order to pursue your personal and financial goals, the many financial components of your life
must work together in harmony. This requires comprehensive planning and a detailed process to pull
it all together. You can learn about our process here.

1
Initial Consultation
Identify and clarify your goals, dreams, special concerns, and challenges.
2
Develop + Finalize Plan
Facilitate conversation around topics such as retirement planning, college savings, life insurance,
investment planning, tax strategies, estate planning, and charitable planning.
3
Execution + Implementation
Create action item list to include recommendations with appropriate schedule for implementation and
accountability.
4
Advancement Planning
Conduct reviews and consultations with outside experts, when appropriate.

## Our Services

Managing Wealth For A Wide Range Of Needs And Goals

Financial Planning

Your financial plan connects all the components of a comprehensive wealth management plan, including
investments, risk management, tax strategies, and estate planning strategies, acting as a roadmap to
help ensure your long-term goals are met.

Investment Management

We believe investing is a means to an end, and it all starts with your financial plan. We believe a
personalized financial plan is a prerequisite to a successful investing experience.

Estate and Legacy Planning

Build a holistic plan for your legacy that provides for loved ones and protects your estate.

Tax Planning

A proactive approach to tax planning helps you better understand what your tax situation may look
like in the future and how the decisions you make today can affect your future wealth.

Insurance and Asset Protection

One of the most important functions we serve is helping to protect all you have worked to build.

## Who We Serve

We serve many different clients with a variety of financial planning needs. Like them, your needs
are as individual as you are. As such, our team is proud – and pleased – to provide you with
professional guidance and an array of financial planning and wealth management services that can be
personalized to fit your situation.

### [ Individuals + Families ][74]

We work to allow clients to live their lives with a purpose and a freedom to focus on their family
and goals.

[ Learn More ][75]

### [ Business Owners ][76]

We partner with business owners to help ensure the stewardship of their legacies.

[ Learn More ][77]

### [ Pre-retirees ][78]

If you are one of the many Americans who plan to retire in the next five to 10 years, it’s time to
determine what shape your retirement savings are in.

[ Learn More ][79]

# Cut Costs with Maintenance Connection CMMS

**Streamline Operations:** Automate work orders, scheduling, and mobile workflows.
**Asset & Inventory Control:** Centralize tracking and manage spare parts efficiently.
**Reporting & Compliance:** Generate reports and stay audit-ready.
[ Start Free Trial ][182]

Trusted by industry leaders across 75+ countries

## Why Choose Maintenance Connection CMMS & EAM

Minimize asset failure, eliminate unplanned downtime, and facilitate agile preventive maintenance
with our feature-rich, purpose-built, multi-site CMMS and EAM solution.

### Simplify Regulatory Compliance

Centralize documentation, automate tasks, establish secure e-signature, precise procedure versioning
and robust audit trails, access reports, and automate workflows.

### Maximize Asset Availability

Enhance repair speed and reduce costs
through efficient spare parts management, optimized labor scheduling, accurate demand forecasting,
and more.

### Increase Quality Control and Boost Efficiency

Streamline maintenance processes, reduce downtime, and extend the lifespan of machinery. Minimize
process deviations by ensuring maintenance activities are always executed on time.

## Explore Maintenance Connection's Flexible Reporting

See how robust reporting and analytics features can help maximize transparency across your
organization and help you to identify maintenance process inefficiencies and cost savings
opportunities.

** For the best experience, please view this page on desktop. **

## Power Enterprise Reporting and Analytics with Accruent Data Connect

Get secure, direct access to cloud‑based, BI‑ready data—and seamlessly integrate it with your
existing BI tools and enterprise systems to unlock faster, more reliable insights.

### Secure, Easy Access to BI‑Ready Data

Access clean, unified and governed datasets designed for enterprise‑scale reporting and analytics,
so teams can move faster with confidence and trust the data behind every decision.

### Simplified Data Workflows and Governance

Eliminate manual data prep, API dependencies and custom integrations when extracting, modeling and
connecting operational data to BI tools and enterprise systems like ERP and finance, ensuring
consistency, control and scalability across the organization.

### Enable Enterprise‑Level, Data‑Driven Decisions

As organizations evolve toward predictive and AI‑driven strategies, Accruent Data Connect provides a
trusted data foundation accelerating time to value, improving ROI and ensuring you’re ready for
what’s next.

[[Learn more about Accruent Data Connect]][188]

## Robust and User-friendly CMMS Platform

Simplify facility management, streamline asset tracking and maximize your return on investment with
a comprehensive, easy-to-use maintenance management software.

### ** Work Order Management**

Unlock your maintenance team's potential, simplify workflows, maximize ROI, and improve your overall
output with centralized, easy-to-use work order management.

### ** Mobile-friendly CMMS**

Empower your team to manage maintenance tasks from anywhere, anytime. Boost productivity and field
responsiveness with mobile-first features, such as offline capabilities and barcode & QR code
scanning.

### ** Actionable Reporting & Analytics**

Use advanced dashboards and configurable maintenance reports to analyze key metrics like work order
completion rates or labor costs, address pain points, and make better maintenance decisions.

[MC-Product-Screenshots_2]
[Esri Device 650w]

### ** Powerful CMMS Security**

Keep your data and operations secure with robust security features. Ensure your maintenance
management system is protected against external threats, control user access, and meet compliance
requirements with ease.

### ** Comprehensive Integrations**

Connect Maintenance Connection to your critical systems, eliminate silos, and enhance workflows with
seamless integrations. Connect to ArcGIS, ERP, SCADA, HR systems, EDMS, IoT, and more using the
pre-built integration hub, or leverage the open API for custom integrations.

### ** Automated Notifications**

Enhance communication with automated alerts and notifications. Keep your team informed, workflows
moving and tasks on schedule without manual intervention.

The AI perceives incoming tickets, reasons through urgency, and autonomously prioritises and routes
them to the appropriate team for swift resolution.

The system assesses technician availability, skill sets, and workload, automatically assigning work
orders to optimise resource distribution for quick service delivery

The AI anticipates potential delays, adjusts priorities, and takes action to meet SLAs and
operational goals proactively

[Helpdesk Ticket Assignment]

##### Helpdesk Ticket Assignment

AI analyzes the problem description and assigns tickets to the appropriate team based on previous
experience and workload. If no prior experience exists, the task is assigned based on workload
balance

[Helpdesk Feedback Collection]

##### Helpdesk Feedback Collection

After resolution, AI autonomously collects and analyses feedback to ensure the issue was fully
addressed, providing insights for continuous improvement.

AI forecasts inventory requirements based on usage patterns, helping maintain optimal stock levels
while minimising waste and preventing shortages

# Software. Reinvented with AI.

Building enterprise software has always been complex, slow, and resource-intensive.

[Pattern]

Even with modern tools, organizations still face challenges:
* [Bullet Icon]
  
  Outdated legacy systems too large or rigid to modernise easily
* [Bullet Icon]
  
  Long development cycles draining time, talent, and budgets
* [Bullet Icon]
  
  Business teams waiting on IT to automate critical processes
* [Bullet Icon]
  
  AI experiments that never make it to production

At SIERRA, we eliminate these roadblocks

## AI That Delivers: Real Business Software, Unbelievably Automated

Our AI-powered solutions don’t stop at code generation. They **build full-stack enterprise
applications, automate structured development workflows, and integrate seamlessly with your existing
systems** — with minimal manual effort.

Whether you’re launching a new platform, extending an existing product, or building internal tools,
our AI accelerators work at scale to deliver real, production–grade outcomes.

tools, you can:

[Legacy Mobile]
* * [bullet icon]

  * [bullet icon]

  * [bullet icon]

  * [bullet icon]

It’s not just faster — it’s smarter, cleaner, and aligned with your long-term tech vision

## SIERRA’s AI Solutions: Beyond Software Development to Intelligent Process Automation

SIERRA’s AI solutions drive intelligent automation across key business departments by using AI
Agents, seamlessly integrating with ERP, CRM, and internal systems

[Icon]Operations & IT
Code Generator, Code Review, SQL Generator and Optimiser tools significantly boost productivity
across operations.
* SIERRA GEN AI Wrapper: This agent serves as a wrapper that calls multiple GenAI tools in the
  background, depending on the type of query. It leverages organizational knowledge and helps
  supervisors track the quality of prompts.
* SIERRA Query Optimiser: AI-powered Query Optimisation for performance and cost improvements
* SIERRA Query Generator: Reads the data dictionary of the database and generates queries based on
  this knowledge. By analysing the user prompt, it understands which tables and columns to use, and
  automatically generates queries, stored procedures, functions, views, and triggers.
* SIERRA Code Generator: This agent has the background knowledge of the application architecture,
  coding structure, and design standards. Based on this knowledge and user inputs, each screen will
  be developed while following common standards and components
* Task Review Agent: Assists in reviewing team members’ task lists, identifies delayed tasks, and
  offers suggestions to speed up progress.
[Icon]Sales & Marketing
* AI Powered Sales Microfunnel: Tracks the stages of Leads/Opportunities and provides guidelines on
  the activities to be performed at each stage. If a Lead/Opportunity is not progressing to the next
  stage, it sends notifications, guides the executive to perform alternate actions, and even
  enforces redoing activities in the previous stage if necessary.
* Automated Insights: Provides data-driven insights to optimise marketing strategies.
[Icon]HR & Finance
* Resume Shortlisting Agent: The AI listens to designated mailboxes and picks up resumes from
  incoming emails. It scans the resumes for relevant details, scores them based on suitability to
  the job description, and generates a shortlist of the top N candidates. This process significantly
  speeds up the recruitment process and assists the HR team in making faster, more informed
  decisions.
* Interview Agent: Supports HR teams by conducting initial rounds of HR and technical interviews,
  evaluating responses, and scoring candidates for further rounds.
[Icon]Customer Support
* AI-powered Helpdesk: Provides instant query resolution, improving response times and customer
  satisfaction.
* 24/7 AI Assistants: Offer round-the-clock customer support, ensuring continuous assistance at any
  time.

## Agentic AI Orchestration: Empowering Smarter Facility Workflows

eFACiLiTY® leverages Agentic AI Orchestration, which autonomously manages and coordinates facility
workflows. By perceiving inputs, reasoning based on goals, and adapting to changing scenarios, the
AI system enables seamless collaboration across IWMS & CAFM systems, ensuring both routine and
complex tasks are executed efficiently.
[Dynamic Ticketing & Real-Time Prioritisation]

##### Dynamic Ticketing & Real-Time Prioritisation

The AI perceives incoming tickets, reasons through urgency, and autonomously prioritises and routes
them to the appropriate team for swift resolution.

[AI-Driven Smart Work Order Allocation]

##### AI-Driven Smart Work Order Allocation

The system assesses technician availability, skill sets, and workload, automatically assigning work
orders to optimise resource distribution for quick service delivery

[Predictive SLA Management]

##### Predictive SLA Management

The AI anticipates potential delays, adjusts priorities, and takes action to meet SLAs and
operational goals proactively

[Helpdesk Ticket Assignment]

##### Helpdesk Ticket Assignment

AI analyzes the problem description and assigns tickets to the appropriate team based on previous
experience and workload. If no prior experience exists, the task is assigned based on workload
balance

[Helpdesk Feedback Collection]

##### Helpdesk Feedback Collection

After resolution, AI autonomously collects and analyses feedback to ensure the issue was fully
addressed, providing insights for continuous improvement.

[Intelligent Inventory Management]

##### Intelligent Inventory Management

AI forecasts inventory requirements based on usage patterns, helping maintain optimal stock levels
while minimising waste and preventing shortages

international, importateurs, exportateurs, distributeurs, fabricants, [grossistes][54], etc.

# Technology to transform maintenance and operations

Get actionable, AI-powered insights to track and manage the entire asset lifecycle, improve capital
planning and boost resiliency for your facilities, equipment and infrastructure.

### Introducing asset management software

After 25+ years supporting clients across industries in keeping critical assets and infrastructure
running, and being acquired by Siemens in 2022, Brightly is now Siemens. Asset management software
saves time, increases productivity and takes the guesswork out of maintenance and capital planning.

We equip technicians to predict and prioritize preventive maintenance activities to maximize asset
performance. Using AI features and billions of data points gathered over decades, this helps
streamline processes, identify asset and equipment-related risks and develop data-driven capital
plans.

Save technicians time

Reduce manual friction with fast, seamless data capture. Automate routine work and surface
instructions, summaries and safety info with Maintenance Copilot.

Make assets last longer

Consolidate data and learnings to take out the guesswork and boost repair accuracy. Rapidly identify
trends to stay ahead of failures.

Get actionable insights

Optimize for increased output and uptime with near real-time access to clean, structured
computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) data.

Simplify compliance

Save time and minimize risk with a centralized permitting process. Lighten the burdens of survey
readiness and increase work order efficiency.

Enhance capital planning

Leverage predictive intelligence to model strategic decisions that extend lifetime value. Align
asset investments to effectively plan for the future.

Predict asset issues

Utilize IoT remote monitoring and predictive maintenance data to anticipate costly asset failures
and schedule maintenance to minimize asset degradation.

### Introducing asset management software

After 25+ years supporting clients across industries in keeping critical assets and infrastructure
running, and being acquired by Siemens in 2022, Brightly is now Siemens. Asset management software
saves time, increases productivity and takes the guesswork out of maintenance and capital planning.

We equip technicians to predict and prioritize preventive maintenance activities to maximize asset
performance. Using AI features and billions of data points gathered over decades, this helps
streamline processes, identify asset and equipment-related risks and develop data-driven capital
plans.

Save technicians time

Reduce manual friction with fast, seamless data capture. Automate routine work and surface
instructions, summaries and safety info with Maintenance Copilot.

Make assets last longer

Consolidate data and learnings to take out the guesswork and boost repair accuracy. Rapidly identify
trends to stay ahead of failures.

Get actionable insights

Optimize for increased output and uptime with near real-time access to clean, structured
computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) data.

Simplify compliance

Save time and minimize risk with a centralized permitting process. Lighten the burdens of survey
readiness and increase work order efficiency.

Enhance capital planning

Leverage predictive intelligence to model strategic decisions that extend lifetime value. Align
asset investments to effectively plan for the future.

Predict asset issues

Utilize IoT remote monitoring and predictive maintenance data to anticipate costly asset failures
and schedule maintenance to minimize asset degradation.

Why Augmentir

## One connected system,

CONNECT

[[AI-based performance optimization for frontline work]][82]

Why Augmentir?

## The smartest way to run your frontline operations

In a world of constant workforce disruption, outdated paper or static processes can’t keep pace.
Frontline digitization is now essential – and Augmentir delivers **smart digitization** across the
entire worker lifecycle, from hire to retire.

Augmentir’s **AI-native connected worker platform** combines Generative AI (via Augie, the first
industrial GenAI suite) with Agentic AI for autonomous, context-aware support. This creates a step
change in how manufacturers develop, train, and support their workforce.

With integrated digital workflows, remote collaboration, skills management, and AI-powered insights,
Augmentir continuously adapts to your dynamic workforce – helping every worker perform at their
best.

[Learn more ][83]
[augmentir connected worker platform]

How We Help

## All-in-One AI-Powered Connected Worker Platform

Augmentir is a connected worker solution that allows industrial companies to digitize and optimize
processes that support frontline workers from “hire to retire”.

The suite of connected worker capabilities are built on top of Augmentir’s patented **Smart AI**
foundation, which closes the loop between training and work execution, delivering the data and
in-line insights necessary to continuously improve operational excellence day-over-day,
year-over-year.

[Explore all features ][84]
[[augmentir connected worker platform]][85]
[augie ai agent studio]
AI Agents

## Build and manage custom AI Agents for your factory

Augmentir’s Industrial AI Agent Studio empowers manufacturers to build, customize, and deploy their
own Industrial AI Agents quickly and easily, with no-code tools, supporting use cases across
workforce training and development, skills management, safety, quality, operations, and maintenance.

[Learn more ][86]
Gen AI Assistant

## Augie™ – Industrial Generative AI Suite

Quickly generate standard work procedures from Excel, Word, PDFs, images, or videos. Augie takes
your existing content and generates digital smart forms, checklists, and immersive digital work
instructions.
* Provide digital assistance to workers
* Create procedures from videos and existing content
* Deliver contextualized training in the flow of work
* Ensure work accuracy and safety with image verification
* Utilize Augie as an autonomous AI Agent

[Learn more ][87]

Augmented Reality

## Modernize training and standard work with Industrial AR

Augmentir AR modernizes training and standard work by putting clear, spatial guidance directly on
equipment and work areas.

For plant managers, trainers, and frontline operators, industrial augmented reality translates to
faster onboarding, fewer errors, and higher first-time-right performance.

Gabriel Solomon Digitization & Smart Technology Manager, Colgate-Palmolive

Replace paper and digitize quality data collection and inspection procedures to reduce errors and

Ensure equipment uptime and yield and improve the safety, quality, and efficiency of assembly and

Give operators more control over equipment cleaning, lubricating, and inspection to identify issues

## Šta mi radimo

Naša stručnost obuhvata prodaju, održavanje i servisiranje industrijskih kompresora, osiguravajući
dugotrajnost i efikasnost vaše opreme.

ŠIROK ASORTIMAN

## Proizvodi u ponudi

Nudimo širok asortiman kompresora za vazduh i gas, prilagođenih različitim industrijskim potrebama.

## Ko smo mi?

Preduzeće BOMIX na tržištu Republike Srbije, nastupa od 1995. godine na održavanju industrijske
rotacione opreme u koju spadaju industrijski kompresori i pumpe. Naša kompanija raspolaže sa veoma
stručnim kadrom i možemo Vam ponuditi kvalitetnu uslugu servisa industrijske rotacione opreme.

Pored pružanja usluge održavanja, već dugi niz godina, uspešno vršimo prodaju vijčanih kompresora za
vazduh i klipnih kompresora za gasove.

Poslujemo na tržištu:
Republike Srbije
Crne Gore
Bosne i Hercegovine
Severne Makedonije
KAKO DO ISPRAVNE MAŠINE

## Servis i održavanje

Sve procedure prilikom servisa i održavanja su propisane od strane proizvodača predmetnih mašina a i
usaglašene su sa standardom ISO 9001:2014. Svakom servisu ili remontu pristupamo detaljno i
pažljivo.

[Detaljnije][12]
Preventivno održavanje

Pre defektaže, vršimo detaljan pregled mašine kako bismo identifikovali uzroke kvarova ili
nepravilnosti u radu.

Servis

Uz dugogodišnje iskustvo kao i direktne preporuke proizvođača opreme, svi naši servisi se izvršavaju
detaljno uz potrebnu tehničku dokumentaciju.

Laserska saosnost osovina i/ili remenica

Laserska saosnost je jedan od glavnih preduslova za normalan start mašine kao i njen dugotrajan i
pravilan rad.

Kontrola vibracija i termovizijsko snimanje

Vibrodijagnostika i termovizijsko snimanje ležajeva mašine je ozbiljna preventivna radnja koja nam
govori u kakvom je stanju mašina, odnosno da li postoje problemi u radu.

# Održavanje, Prodaja i Servis Industrijske Rotacione Opreme

DO

Godina garancije
na kompresore

+

Srbije i regiona

+

kompresora u ponudi

S iskustvom koje traje decenijama, pružamo vrhunska rešenja za servisiranje i optimizaciju vaše
opreme.

[Proizvodi][9][O nama][10]
SIGURNOST NA PRVOM MESTU

## Šta mi radimo

Naša stručnost obuhvata prodaju, održavanje i servisiranje industrijskih kompresora, osiguravajući
dugotrajnost i efikasnost vaše opreme.

ŠIROK ASORTIMAN

## Proizvodi u ponudi

Nudimo širok asortiman kompresora za vazduh i gas, prilagođenih različitim industrijskim potrebama.

[Pogledaj sve][11]
[Image]

## Kompresori za vazduh

Kompresori za vazduh obezbeđuju pouzdano snabdevanje komprimovanim vazduhom za različite
industrijske i zanatske primene.

Karakteristike
Sigurnost
Pouzdanost
Dugotrajnost
Tehnička podrška
[Image]

## Kompresori za gas

TIGHT kompresori su vertikalni bezuljni kompresori visokih perfomansi, malih ugradbenih dimenzija,
za stacionarnu ili mobilnu upotrebu.

Karakteristike
Tehnička podrška
Sigurnost u radu
Pouzdanost
Ponuda raznih modela
[Image]
NEŠTO O NAMA

## Ko smo mi?

Preduzeće BOMIX na tržištu Republike Srbije, nastupa od 1995. godine na održavanju industrijske
rotacione opreme u koju spadaju industrijski kompresori i pumpe. Naša kompanija raspolaže sa veoma
stručnim kadrom i možemo Vam ponuditi kvalitetnu uslugu servisa industrijske rotacione opreme.

Pored pružanja usluge održavanja, već dugi niz godina, uspešno vršimo prodaju vijčanih kompresora za
vazduh i klipnih kompresora za gasove.

Poslujemo na tržištu:
Republike Srbije
Crne Gore
Bosne i Hercegovine
Severne Makedonije
KAKO DO ISPRAVNE MAŠINE

## Servis i održavanje

Sve procedure prilikom servisa i održavanja su propisane od strane proizvodača predmetnih mašina a i
usaglašene su sa standardom ISO 9001:2014. Svakom servisu ili remontu pristupamo detaljno i
pažljivo.

[Detaljnije][12]
Preventivno održavanje

Pre defektaže, vršimo detaljan pregled mašine kako bismo identifikovali uzroke kvarova ili
nepravilnosti u radu.

Servis

Uz dugogodišnje iskustvo kao i direktne preporuke proizvođača opreme, svi naši servisi se izvršavaju
detaljno uz potrebnu tehničku dokumentaciju.

Laserska saosnost osovina i/ili remenica

Laserska saosnost je jedan od glavnih preduslova za normalan start mašine kao i njen dugotrajan i
pravilan rad.

Kontrola vibracija i termovizijsko snimanje

Vibrodijagnostika i termovizijsko snimanje ležajeva mašine je ozbiljna preventivna radnja koja nam
govori u kakvom je stanju mašina, odnosno da li postoje problemi u radu.

[Image]
[Image]
[Image]
[Image]
KAKO DO ISPRAVNE MAŠINE

## Smanjite rizik, centrirajte mašine

Pravilno centriranje mašina ne samo da smanjuje habanje i produžava njihov radni vek, već i značajno
smanjuje rizik od neplaniranih zastoja, čime se povećava efikasnost i smanjuju troškovi održavanja.

best suit customers’ requirements. Streamline your operations and enhance your maintenance
management capabilities with DimoMaint!

[ [DimomaintMX 550X412][DimomaintMX 550X412] ][91]
* **Asset maintenance**
* Any industry & sector
* Cloud-based CMMS
* Available in **18 languages**

[ [DimoMaint-FM-Home][DimoMaint-FM-Home] ][94]

[Facility management][Facility management]

[Facility management][117]

### Optimize the management of your real estate portfolio
* An organized and intuitive structure (sites/buildings, floors, rooms, equipment)
* A detailed logbook including technical specifications, square footage, documentation, GPS
  coordinates and job records
* Quick identification using QR codes.

[Resource management][Resource management]

[Resource management][118]

### Improve management of your engineers and subcontractors
* Ability to create as many resources as needed per site and location
* Management of third parties
* Customer access portal
* Development of checklists associated to both reactive and scheduled maintenance tasks.

[Scheduled maintenance][Scheduled maintenance]

[Scheduled maintenance][119]

### Ensure compliance for all your assets
* Specific tracking of essential regulatory controls to validate audits
* Global view of scheduled maintenance activities by site, easily accessible on the calendar
* Customized forms (checklists, risk assessments, meter readings, work permits; health and safety
  reports, surveys).

[KPIs & dashboards][KPIs & dashboards]

[KPIs & dashboards][120]

### Review your maintenance performance
* Customized Reporting.
* Expenses Monitoring.
* Dashboard of KPIs.
* Compliancy & SLAs.

## Platform solutions driving your business forward.

### Intelligent workplace.

* Work orders and preventive maintenance
* Integration with Autodesk

[ Explore Integrated operations ][86]

Platform solution

### IWMS for complex environments.

When the asset, facility, and workplace complexity requires a highly customizable solution.
* OnPrem/SaaS IWMS
* Mobile technician app
* FedRAMP Authorized
* 50+ Integrations

[ Explore Archibus ][87]

## Modular apps. Integrated intelligence.

Our apps share one architecture, giving teams flexibility without risk. Security, control, and
consistency are integral to the platform.

[Eptura Engage]

Workplace experience and resource scheduling solution that help teams plan their workweek,
collaborate effectively, and optimize space to improve workplace productivity.

[Eptura Engage app on laptop and phone]
[Learn more][88]
[Asset]

Enterprise asset management solution for facility and asset management teams to track, maintain and
extend the life of physical assets across facilities, fleets and field operations.

[Asset app on laptop and phone]
[Learn more][89]
[Eptura Workplace]

Workplace operations solution for space management and real estate teams to manage space, coordinate
office moves, and streamline day-to-day operations.

[Eptura Workplace app on laptop and phone]
[Learn more][90]
[Eptura Visitor]

Secure and intuitive visitor management solution for security and front desk teams to streamline
check-in, control access, and deliver a seamless visitor experience.

[Eptura Visitor app on laptop and tablet]
[Learn more][91]
[Eptura Archibus]

A FedRAMP Authorized IWMS that streamlines building maintenance, vendor assignment, and workplace
operations across complex environments.

[Eptura Archibus app on laptop and phone]
[Learn more][92]
[Eptura Serraview]

Global portfolio optimization for real estate and space planning teams with scenario planning,
visual block and stack and SerraviewLive for real-time utilization insights.

[Eptura Serraview app on laptop and phone]
[Learn more][93]

## Proven ROI for our customers.

$11M
Divested in real estate for #1 Global Insurance Provider.
80%
Savings by extending asset life for $10M equipment inventory.
2X
Faster restack for publicly traded tech company.

> “Eptura supports so many aspects of our work.”

Tera Oswald
Head, Global Portfolio Strategy & Workplace Services, BMO
[Learn more][94]

## Eptura AI at your service.

Eptura AI turns data into action - smarter real estate, streamlined operations, and better workplace
experiences.

This content is subject to our [disclaimer][95].

### Intelligent collaboration.

Plan your office days and which spaces will give you the most facetime with colleagues.

### Predictive ecosystems.

Boost efficiency and improve sustainability with advanced insights into your maintenance operations.

#### Pattern-based reservations.

Leverage behavioral insights to match employees with optimal spaces, driving higher utilization and
a frictionless experience.

#### Automated team days.

Instantly coordinate in-office schedules and reserve team-wide workspaces following seating
preferences.

#### Leadership-ready dashboards.

Optimize your real estate footprint with genuine insights into your portfolio performance.

#### Facial recognition for visitor access.

Accelerate visitor entry and bolster security using facial recognition technology to validate
identity.

[Learn more][96]

## Fresh perspectives.

Check out the latest research, network with peers, and tune into our podcast.

### 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Workplace Experience Applications

See why Eptura is named a Leader

[ View report ][97]

### Workplace Index

2026 report coming soon

The standard for workplace research to help you benchmark and strategize.

[ Learn more ][98]

### Defining Your Workplace

Episode 400 | 56:49

In episode 400, host Mike Petrusky gathers six returning guests from the IFMA community

[ Play episode ][99]

### Spring product announcement

Built around how work really happens.

[ Learn more ][100]

## Eptura for government.

Get complete visibility and control over spaces, assets, and facilities with [Archibus for
Government][101], a FedRAMP Authorized environment.

### Real estate portfolio

Strengthen real estate planning and accountability with clear visibility into your agency's full
facility and space portfolio.

### Asset optimization

Improve asset lifecycle management with accurate tracking, preventive maintenance, and audit-ready
reporting.

### Enhanced compliance

Operate buildings and facilities confidently with a FedRAMP Authorized platform built for secure
data, accountability, and regulatory compliance.

[ Eptura for government ][102]

## Looking to switch?

We're prepared to be your partner to evaluate and migrate to Eptura – from initial pitch to full
deployment.

## FAQs

How Cameras Are Integrated into OEE with Fabrico?

Cameras act as an **additional visibility layer** in Fabrico’s OEE system — capturing the human and
process context that sensors or PLC data alone can’t provide. Combining **machine + human interface
+ camera data** allows Fabrico to move from partial to full visibility.

#### **1. Capturing True Equipment Availability**
* Cameras detect when a machine is stopped, even if sensors don’t register it (e.g., when a line is
  technically “on” but not producing) and people do not report.
* They help validate **microstops, idle time, and manual interventions**, closing the gap between
  logged and real downtime.
* Visual events are automatically time-stamped and linked to machine IDs, updating **Availability**
  metrics in real time.

#### **2. Improving Performance Accuracy**
* By analyzing cycle patterns visually, cameras verify whether production runs at the correct speed.
* They identify **manual slowdowns, material jams, or hesitation in operator actions** — causes
  often missed by machine data.
* This refines **Performance** calculations, ensuring every second of lost production speed is
  captured.

#### **3. Enhancing Quality Tracking**
* Cameras can spot **defects, misalignments, or rejected parts** during the production process.
* These quality losses are instantly associated with machine or batch records, improving **Quality**
  accuracy within OEE.

#### **4. Linking Human and Machine Data**
* Fabrico connects vision data with operator activity, work orders, and machine states — creating a
  **“digital twin”** of production.
* This enables teams to see not just *what* stopped the line, but *who*, *why*, and *how* it
  happened.

# Gym Equipment Repair NYC & Long Island

Professional repair services for treadmills, ellipticals, and strength equipment. Serving Manhattan,
Brooklyn, Queens, Bronx, Staten Island, and Nassau/Suffolk counties.

[Request a Quote][49] [Our Services][50]
Certified Technicians We Come To You NYC & LI Specialists

## Gym Equipment Services in NY

Specialized repair and maintenance for commercial and home gyms in NYC and Long Island.

### Treadmill Repair

Diagnostics and repair for treadmill belt issues, motor malfunctions, and console errors.
* Belt replacement & adjustment
* Motor troubleshooting
* Console & circuit board repair

[View Treadmill Services →][51]

### Elliptical Repair

Fixing noise issues, resistance problems, and pedal malfunctions on all major brands.
* Stride mechanism repair
* Resistance system fixes
* Bearing & bushing replacement

[View Elliptical Services →][52]

### Exercise Bike Repair

Repair for stationary and spin bikes (including Peloton), focusing on resistance and pedals.
* Flywheel & belt drive repair
* Magnetic resistance fixes
* Screen & connectivity issues

[View Bike Services →][53]

### Strength Machine Repair

Cable replacement, weight stack repair, and structural fixes for multi-gyms and functional trainers.
* Cable & pulley replacement
* Weight stack servicing
* Frame & structural repair

[View Strength Services →][54]

#### Preventive Maintenance

Scheduled maintenance to extend equipment life and prevent breakdowns in high-traffic NY gyms.

[Learn More →][55]

#### Installation & Assembly

Professional assembly for new equipment purchases to ensure warranty compliance.

[Learn More →][56]

#### Moving & Relocation

Safe disassembly, transport, and reassembly services within the Tri-State area.

[Learn More →][57]

Common Equipment Issues
* Console errors & display malfunctions
* Belt slipping & alignment problems
* Motor overheating & burning smells
* Unusual noises during operation
Professional Service

## Why Professional Gym Equipment Repair Matters

Proper maintenance and repair of fitness equipment ensures safety, extends equipment lifespan, and
protects your investment. Professional technicians have the specialized knowledge needed to diagnose
complex issues that general handymen might miss.
* ### Specialized Tools & Equipment
  
  Professional repair services use manufacturer-specific diagnostic tools to accurately identify
  electronic and mechanical issues with modern fitness equipment.
* ### Technical Knowledge
  
  Fitness equipment repair requires specific knowledge of mechanical systems, electronics, and the
  unique requirements of different equipment brands and models.
* ### Safety Considerations
  
  Improperly repaired equipment can pose serious safety risks. Professional service ensures all
  safety mechanisms are functioning correctly after repairs.
* ### Preventive Care
  
  Professional technicians can identify potential issues before they cause major failures, helping
  to minimize downtime and extend equipment lifespan.

[Request Service Information][58]

### What areas specifically do you cover? +

Our technicians cover the entire New York City region (Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, Bronx, Staten
Island), all of Nassau County and Suffolk County on Long Island, and Westchester Count

# Enterprise Asset Management and Predictive Maintenance CMMS+ Software

TRY ROI CALCULATOR

### Slash unplanned downtime

Cut unplanned workloads by as much as 44% within 12 months of deployment.

### Finish repairs faster

Facilities report cutting mean time to repair (MTTR) by nearly 26%.

### Risk, managed

Identify and prioritize critical machines – reducing downtime.

## Know the status of every machine in your care

[facility workers talking]

“I don’t know” isn’t acceptable when your production line goes down. You need to know why. LLumin
gives you the real-time status of every machine in your plant — and lets you control the outcomes.
Guesswork? Those days are over.

[ See how LLumin works ][71]
[facility workers talking]

## Optimize preventive maintenance

Discover how LLumin CMMS+ helps organizations improve preventive maintenance planning, reduce
unplanned downtime, and extend asset life. With powerful CMMS capabilities, predictive maintenance
tools, and real-time operational visibility, LLumin enables maintenance teams to work smarter and
achieve greater reliability across facilities and critical assets.

Watch the video to see LLumin CMMS+ in action and learn how it can transform your maintenance
strategy.

## Engineer certainty into your maintenance program

[LLumin dashboard manager]

While CMMS vendors spend tons of effort and time acting like they get it, LLumin built a product
that real maintenance folks actually find useful. Our team of IoT professionals understands
industrial plants — and we know any old CMMS, no matter how “cute” or “fun” it looks, just won’t do.

[ Learn more ][72]
[LLumin dashboard manager]

## Compliance-ready by design

[workers using laptop in facility]

Build compliance into your everyday processes with LLumin. Safety protocols are met and monitored —
plus you’ll get automatic notifications if something goes awry. And when an auditor calls, your
archive of past maintenance work, purchases, notifications and their approvals are just a few easy
clicks away.

[ Learn more ][73]
[workers using laptop in facility]

## Delegate from anywhere

[HMI device]

Assign work directly from a human-machine interface (HMI), tablet or mobile device — seamlessly
exchanging data between technicians, operators and managers.

[ Learn more ][74]
[HMI device]

## LLumin CMMS+ OMG Roofing Testimonial

Hear directly from the team at OMG as they share their experience with LLumin CMMS+ and the impact
it has had on their maintenance operations. From improved visibility and streamlined workflows to
more proactive asset management, discover how LLumin helps organizations increase efficiency and
drive better maintenance outcomes.

Watch the video to learn how LLumin supports reliability, performance, and operational success.

[facility workers talking]

achieve greater reliability across facilities and critical assets.

industrial plants — and we know any old CMMS, no matter how “cute” or “fun” it looks, just won’t do.

archive of past maintenance work, purchases, notifications and their approvals are just a few easy
clicks away.

[ Learn more ][73]

## Delegate from anywhere

[HMI device]

Assign work directly from a human-machine interface (HMI), tablet or mobile device — seamlessly
exchanging data between technicians, operators and managers.

# Simple CMMS for small plants that still run maintenance from spreadsheets, whiteboards, and paper.

Get every job, PM, and spare part out of scattered notes and into one place your whole team can see
— work orders, PM schedules, parts, asset history, and KPI dashboards, without enterprise
complexity.

[Start your 30-day free trial][9][Get the free Excel CMMS][10]

Everything in one place

## One system for the
## whole operation.

Stop stitching together spreadsheets, binders, and group texts. MaintainFlow puts the maintenance
work, the schedule, the parts, and the numbers in one place your whole team can reach.

### Digital work orders

Create, assign, and close jobs with checklists, parts, and labour. Every work order gets a reference
and a full history — no more whiteboards or lost paper.

[Learn more →][11]

### Automatic preventive maintenance

PM schedules generate work orders on their own. Pass/fail inspection checks — and a failed check
raises a follow-up job automatically, so nothing slips.

[Learn more →][12]

### Spare parts & inventory

On-hand counts, reorder points, and low-stock flags. Consume parts against a job and stock updates
itself, so the storeroom stays honest.

### Reliability KPI dashboard

Backlog, PMs due, low stock, and parts cost on one screen. Lead the operation with numbers instead
of gut feel.

### Your team, with roles

Invite your whole crew. Owners, managers, and technicians each see exactly what they should —
company-scoped and secure.

### Runs anywhere

Works in the browser on the shop PC, the office laptop, or a phone at the asset. Nothing to install,
always up to date.

company-scoped and secure.

# CMMS Software

## Unlock the full potential of your maintenance team with Maintastic CMMS

Maintastic CMMS combines artificial intelligence (AI) with human collaboration. Take your
maintenance operations to the next level by digitizing workflows, planning tasks proactively, and
solving technical challenges more efficiently.
This not only boosts your machine availability in the long run – it also sparks real enthusiasm for
using cutting-edge maintenance software.
[ Get a demo ][41]

## Get to know Maintastic in 90 seconds

See how modern maintenance works with Maintastic – from AI-powered ticketing and mobile maintenance
to digital work orders. This CMMS combines intelligent features with an intuitive interface to
increase efficiency, transparency, and equipment availability across the entire maintenance process.

[Video Preview] ►
×
🔈

## Everything your maintenance team needs

Asset management Maintenance planning Work orders Work instructions AI agent Live collaboration
[Maintenance technician with tablet keeps track of machines in Maintastic.]

### Asset management

Easily manage all assets and maintenance activities from a single platform. Technicians and
operators can access technical documents, service histories, and key contact directly at the
machine—simply by scanning a QR code or tapping an NFC tag.
[ Discover more ][42]
[Industrial robotic arm with overlaid maintenance tasks for weekly cable check and monthly sensor
inspection.]

### Maintenance planning

Whether it’s a recurring task or a one-time job, plan and assign maintenance work with total control
and clarity.
[ Discover more ][43]
[Maintenance technician documents repair in CMMS of a damaged pump and checks open maintenance
tickets using a tablet.]

### Mobile work orders

Each work order consolidates all essential details—tasks, deadlines, and assigned responsibilities.
Technicians can easily filter, update, and complete work orders on the go, adding comments, photos,
or videos as needed.
[ Discover more ][44]
[Overview with three work instructions in the CMMS, including oil change on robotic arm, failure
diagnosis, and quality check on filling machine.]

### Checklists & work instructions

Digital checklists and work instructions lead technicians and machine operators safely through each
task. Structured forms make it easy to document maintenance work accurately and consistently.
[ Discover more ][45]
[AI assistant displays suggested solutions based on completed orders.]

### Speak instead of typing – your smart AI agent

The AI agent allows you to create voice-activated reports in any language, get instant translations,
generate precise, data-rich service tickets, and access key information in seconds via an integrated
chatbot.
[ Discover more ][46]
[Technician on a remote assistance call with expert, both smiling and communicating live via
smartphone and headset.]

### Live collaboration with remote assistance

Maintastic brings technicians and machine experts together in real time. Everyone sees the same
view, resolves issues faster, and captures valuable solution knowledge directly in the CMMS.
[ Discover more ][47]

## Proven impact – how Maintastic transforms maintenance across industries

[Maintenance technician with tablet keeps track of machines in Maintastic.]

### General manufacturing

Maintastic brings technicians, machine operators, and production teams together as a unified force
on the shop floor. This innovative manufacturing maintenance software helps you sustainably digitize
processes, boost machine availability, and enhance overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).
[ Explore industry ][48]
[Maintenance technician in protective clothing performs maintenance on a conveyor belt in a
cleanroom, machine is in error state.]

### Pharma & Life Sciences

In the pharmaceutical industry and life sciences, every minute matters. Downtime impacts not only
productivity but also the quality and safety of sensitive production and analytical processes. As a
modern maintenance management system (CMMS) and an established software for pharmaceutical
manufacturers, Maintastic optimizes cleanroom operations and minimizes costly downtime.
[ Explore industry ][49]
[Technician with smartphone stands in front of a crawler excavator, shown as online with location
and asset details.]

### Construction & mining

Whether in civil engineering, road construction, mining, or large-scale construction projects,
Maintastic is the all-in-one management software for fleet operators and OEMs seeking to digitize
their maintenance and technical customer service. Fleet operators gain full visibility into
machines, maintenance schedules, and error reports. OEMs and dealers enhance service communication,
minimize downtime, and deliver new digital service offerings.
[ Explore industry ][50]

## Unlock peak performance with next-gen maintenance

Over 150 companies already rely on Maintastic to manage their machines, equipment, and facilities
with digital maintenance and service software.
[Technician uses tablet and CMMS to perform weekly maintenance and calibration on industrial
equipment, tasks marked as in progress.]

FAQ

## CMMS questions, answered

Everything you need to know about CMMS software, implementation, pricing, and security. Can't find
your answer? [Book a demo][26] — our team responds within one business day.

### What is a CMMS?

A CMMS (computerized maintenance management system) is software that centralizes maintenance
operations: work orders, preventive maintenance schedules, asset history, and spare-parts inventory.
Teams use it to plan and track repairs, reduce unplanned downtime, and report on KPIs like MTTR,
MTBF, and PM compliance from one dashboard.

### What is the difference between CMMS and EAM software?

A CMMS focuses on day-to-day maintenance execution — work orders, PM scheduling, parts, and
technician workflows — while EAM (enterprise asset management) covers the full asset lifecycle
including procurement, depreciation, and disposal. MaintPro delivers CMMS depth with EAM-grade
scalability: multi-site hierarchies, ERP integrations, and enterprise reporting without EAM
complexity.

### How does a CMMS reduce unplanned downtime?

A CMMS reduces downtime by catching failures before they happen: preventive maintenance triggered by
time, usage, or sensor condition; automated work-order routing that cuts response time; and parts
availability checks so repairs are never blocked. MaintPro customers report up to 42% less unplanned
downtime within the first year.

### How long does CMMS implementation take?

Most teams go live on MaintPro in under a week. Our launch team handles asset imports, workflow
configuration, and user provisioning. Enterprise deployments with ERP integrations typically
complete in 3–6 weeks, including testing and cut-over.

### How much does CMMS software cost?

CMMS pricing is typically per technician per month, and MaintPro follows that model with volume
discounts for multi-site rollouts. Every plan includes unlimited assets, free data migration, and
the mobile field app. Start with the free 14-day trial — no credit card required — and we'll quote
your exact configuration.

### Can MaintPro integrate with our existing ERP and IoT sensors?

Yes. We ship native connectors for SAP, Oracle, IBM Maximo, and 40+ IoT and telematics platforms,
plus a fully documented REST API and webhooks for anything custom. Our integration engineers scope
and build the connection as part of onboarding.

### Does the mobile app work offline for field technicians?

Yes — the mobile app is offline-first. Technicians can view work orders, complete checklists,
capture photos, and log parts usage without a signal, and everything syncs automatically once
they're back online.

### Can MaintPro scale across multiple sites and teams?

Yes. MaintPro is built for multi-site operations: unlimited assets, site hierarchies, cross-site
reporting, and role-based access control. Start with a single facility and roll out to hundreds of
locations on the same platform without re-implementation.

### How is our maintenance data secured?

Data is encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3), with role-based access control and
full audit logging on every plan. Enterprise customers can choose regional hosting or private cloud
deployment.

### Can we migrate data from our current CMMS?

Yes — migration is free on every plan. We provide templated importers for the major legacy systems
and spreadsheets, and our team validates the migration with you before go-live so no work-order
history is lost.

### What does the free trial include?

The 14-day trial includes every feature with no user limit and no credit card required. At the end,
keep your configuration and data if you subscribe — or export everything with one click.

FAQ

## CMMS questions, answered

Everything you need to know about CMMS software, implementation, pricing, and security. Can't find
your answer? [Book a demo][26] — our team responds within one business day.

### What is a CMMS?

A CMMS (computerized maintenance management system) is software that centralizes maintenance
operations: work orders, preventive maintenance schedules, asset history, and spare-parts inventory.
Teams use it to plan and track repairs, reduce unplanned downtime, and report on KPIs like MTTR,
MTBF, and PM compliance from one dashboard.

### What is the difference between CMMS and EAM software?

A CMMS focuses on day-to-day maintenance execution — work orders, PM scheduling, parts, and
technician workflows — while EAM (enterprise asset management) covers the full asset lifecycle
including procurement, depreciation, and disposal. MaintPro delivers CMMS depth with EAM-grade
scalability: multi-site hierarchies, ERP integrations, and enterprise reporting without EAM
complexity.

### How does a CMMS reduce unplanned downtime?

A CMMS reduces downtime by catching failures before they happen: preventive maintenance triggered by
time, usage, or sensor condition; automated work-order routing that cuts response time; and parts
availability checks so repairs are never blocked. MaintPro customers report up to 42% less unplanned
downtime within the first year.

### How long does CMMS implementation take?

Most teams go live on MaintPro in under a week. Our launch team handles asset imports, workflow
configuration, and user provisioning. Enterprise deployments with ERP integrations typically
complete in 3–6 weeks, including testing and cut-over.

### How much does CMMS software cost?

CMMS pricing is typically per technician per month, and MaintPro follows that model with volume
discounts for multi-site rollouts. Every plan includes unlimited assets, free data migration, and
the mobile field app. Start with the free 14-day trial — no credit card required — and we'll quote
your exact configuration.

### Can MaintPro integrate with our existing ERP and IoT sensors?

Yes. We ship native connectors for SAP, Oracle, IBM Maximo, and 40+ IoT and telematics platforms,
plus a fully documented REST API and webhooks for anything custom. Our integration engineers scope
and build the connection as part of onboarding.

### Does the mobile app work offline for field technicians?

Yes — the mobile app is offline-first. Technicians can view work orders, complete checklists,
capture photos, and log parts usage without a signal, and everything syncs automatically once
they're back online.

### Can MaintPro scale across multiple sites and teams?

Yes. MaintPro is built for multi-site operations: unlimited assets, site hierarchies, cross-site
reporting, and role-based access control. Start with a single facility and roll out to hundreds of
locations on the same platform without re-implementation.

### How is our maintenance data secured?

Data is encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3), with role-based access control and
full audit logging on every plan. Enterprise customers can choose regional hosting or private cloud
deployment.

### Can we migrate data from our current CMMS?

Yes — migration is free on every plan. We provide templated importers for the major legacy systems
and spreadsheets, and our team validates the migration with you before go-live so no work-order
history is lost.

### What does the free trial include?

The 14-day trial includes every feature with no user limit and no credit card required. At the end,
keep your configuration and data if you subscribe — or export everything with one click.

### What are CMMS Modules?

CMMS preventive maintenance software modules represent the various capabilities included in a
facilities maintenance management system. Typically, the base module is the work order management
system. As such, nearly all preventive maintenance software programs have this basic module. Indeed,
many systems *only* have this one module and perform all maintenance functions as work orders.
Similarly, our software *has the ability* to perform all maintenance functions as a work order as
well. However, our solution *also includes a dedicated PM software module, a downtime module, a
complete spare parts management system and a complete purchasing management system*. Accordingly,
one software solution serves all functions of a working maintenance team.

##### Reporting and Analysis Modules

Some maintenance teams elect to use all CMMS modules. Others use one module or a combination of two
or more modules. Of course, the choice is yours and the program works beautifully either way.
Furthermore, our [CMMS software][105] includes extensive analysis and reporting for each of the
primary software modules within the system. These analysis modules provide extensive key performance
indicators (KPIs) and reporting information on all aspects of the facilities maintenance management
system. Best of all, these analysis tools guide the maintenance manager in planning,
[scheduling][106], compliance, policy making and optimization of the overall maintenance program.
Eventually, this leads to cost-savings, a focused and efficient maintenance team as well as a
smoother running machinery in general.
